_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to roster.json and register participants as they join.
The register is open during the announced contribution window.
Existing and newly generated signing keys are allowed; no minimum key age.
Publish public keys under the participant identity before acceptance.
Record the register revision and digest with each accepted contribution.
Append new identities; do not rewrite accepted identities or keys.
Key material is inline so verification does not depend on fetching it.
published_at records public identity evidence for human review.
independent_of_operator is a JSON boolean declaration, not verified fact.
An agent on the operator machine must be declared non-independent.
Independent participation is a final acceptance gate, not an opening gate.
